title: Advisory on Part-time Job Scams
summary: Ministry of Home Affairs warns citizens against online part-time job offers via WhatsApp/Telegram that ask for investments.

title: PAN-Aadhaar Linking Deadline Extended
summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has extended the deadline for linking PAN with Aadhaar card to prevent PAN deactivation.

title: Launch of PM Vishwakarma Scheme Portal
summary: Prime Minister launches the new portal for PM Vishwakarma, allowing traditional artisans to register and claim incentives.

title: Alert: Fake Electricity Bill SMS
summary: Power grid companies warn consumers not to click links in messages claiming their electricity will be disconnected.

title: NSP Open for Fresh Registrations
summary: National Scholarship Portal is now open for pre-matric and post-matric applications for the academic year 2026-27.

title: Mandatory e-KYC for PM Kisan Beneficiaries
summary: Department of Agriculture reminds all registered landholders to complete biometric or OTP e-KYC before the next payout.

title: New Guidelines for DigiLocker Accounts
summary: DigiLocker enhances user security by introducing six-digit PIN and two-factor authentication for government document access.

title: Digital India Internship Applications Open
summary: Ministry of Electronics & IT invites applications for the summer batch of Digital India Internship Scheme from tech graduates.

title: Advisory: Do Not Share OTP for Courier Delivery
summary: Police departments caution citizens against OTP sharing with delivery agents demanding fees for unexpected packages.

title: PM Awas Yojana Gramin Direct Benefit Transfer
summary: First installment of house building subsidy transferred directly to over 50,000 rural beneficiaries under PMAY-G.

title: UDID Card Registration Drives in Rural Districts
summary: Ministry of Social Justice organizes block-level camps to identify and register specially-abled citizens for UDID cards.

title: Udyam MSME Registration Reaches Milestone
summary: Ministry of MSME announces that active Udyam registrations have crossed 2 Crore, enabling small businesses to access credit.

title: Advisory against Fake Government Websites
summary: National Informatics Centre publishes a guide on identifying fake websites mimicking official government domains.

title: Unified Highway Helpline 1033 Operational
summary: NHAI announces nationwide activation of 1033 helpline for emergency support and towing services on national highways.

title: Free Soil Testing Scheme for Farmers
summary: Krishi Vigyan Kendras organize free soil testing campaigns to help farmers optimize fertilizer application for kharif crops.

title: Central Consumer Protection Authority Advisory
summary: CCPA issues guidelines to prevent unfair trade practices and misleading advertisements on e-commerce platforms.

title: E-Shram Portal Integrates with NCS
summary: Workers registered on e-Shram can now search and apply for jobs on the National Career Service portal with one click.

title: Railway Security App Features Upgraded
summary: Indian Railways upgrades the safety app with direct video-calling to local RPF assistance booths for female passengers.

title: Special Ayushman Card Campaign in Urban Slums
summary: Municipal corporations launch a 15-day drive to register daily-wage workers for the PM-JAY health insurance scheme.

title: Consumer Grievance Redressal Fortnight
summary: National Consumer Helpline organizes a fortnight dedicated to resolving pending service provider complaints.
